admission.justification: The optional authority and command refusal prevent starting or stopping an implicit developer daemon when no runtime was selected.

applicability: Paseo provision, status and stop CLI requests.
exclusions: HTTP launch routes retain their own projected status codes.
statement: An absent `paseoRuntime` block is the named state "no Paseo runtime configured" (`None`), a present block requires the five operational facts with `providers` and `embed` allowed empty and an optional `version` that never selects another release, and each of the three commands refuses the named state with code `paseo_runtime_not_configured` and exit status 2 before any process is started.
